name: Room Hub
goal: Jarvis's hands in the dorm room: lamp and fan through UL-listed IoT relays, the overhead light by a servo on the wall rocker, a dimmable 12 V desk strip, and temperature, light, door and presence, all reported to Jarvis every 3 s. Nothing touches mains or the walls.
notes: Ultron drafted the enclosure, the switch-pusher mount, the door housings and the layout; parts, wiring and firmware were finished outside the workshop and checked here.

printed.name: Hub Enclosure
notes: Enclosure for ESP32 and MOSFET with ventilation slots.

printed.name: Switch Pusher Mount
notes: Clamp-on mount for MG996R servo to actuate wall rocker switc

printed.name: Door Sensor Housing
notes: Housing for Hall effect sensor and magnet on door frame.

extras.item: Digital Loggers IoT Power Relay (UL-listed, 3.3 V control input) - lamp: control + to IO16, - to GND
Digital Loggers IoT Power Relay - fan: control + to IO17, - to GND
12 V LED strip, 1 m (under 1.5 A): + to PS12 +, - to Q1 drain
Neodymium magnet, 6 x 3 mm (for the door)
